clips.title: The story
paras: In Ban'ethil Barrow Den, the Raven Claw Talisman is kept among relics needed to awaken sleeping druids. The sacred night elf relic is one of four Relics of Wakening used to guide the Druids of the Talon safely back from the Emerald Dream.

The Raven Claw Talisman rests in a designated chest inside Ban'ethil Barrow Den, where Teldrassil's Druids of the Talon entered deep meditative sleep. Their hibernation is a delicate spiritual threshold. Without the proper ceremonial focus, a druid whose link to the waking world is broken may remain stranded in the Emerald Dream. Athridas Bearmantle in Dolanaar needs this talisman, the Black Feather Quill, the Sapphire of Sky, and the Rune of Nesting to perform the awakening ritual and bring the sleepers back safely.

Corrupted Gnarlpine furbolgs have overrun Ban'ethil Barrow Den, putting its sacred chests and sleeping druids in peril. Their desecration has cut the sanctuary off from outside aid, and the relics may be lost or destroyed. Athridas Bearmantle calls on Teldrassil's defenders to brave the den's winding earthen corridors and secure the Raven Claw Talisman before the displaced druids are lost to the Dream forever.
